verdict.rationale: Factory's Agent Readiness docs describe a `/readiness-report` slash command that evaluates a repository's readiness level for agents. It runs in the Factory App (web or desktop) and in the Droid CLI. A companion `/readiness-fix` command can automatically fix failing criteria. Missing for 10: detail on the evaluated criteria and readiness-level scale, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
